### Verdict & Price Target

STRONG BUY on Apple Inc. (AAPL) with a $265.00 price target against a $210.35 entry, an
implied upside of 26.0% over a 45-day horizon. The target triangulates the $291.00 DCF
intrinsic value against the $245.00 technical resistance level; no peer multiple or analyst
consensus input was supplied. Every one of the six signals points the same
direction, which is rare and is the reason conviction sits at 0.67. The single most important
driver is earnings quality: 9.6% revenue growth with 140bps of margin expansion and OCF/NI
above 1.08 in both trailing quarters is clean, cash-backed growth, and consensus has been
revised up 4.1% over three months to meet it.

### Bull Case

Services is doing the work. Segment growth of 14.2% against 9.6% at the consolidated level is
mechanically expanding gross margin, and the DCF is most sensitive to exactly that variable —
each 100bps of terminal FCF margin moves fair value roughly $13 per share. The base case of
$291.00 assumes 27.5% terminal FCF margin; the trailing trend argues that assumption is
conservative rather than aggressive.

The competitive position supports the multiple. A 2.2B active device base with demonstrated
pricing power, ASPs up 6% into a flat unit market, is the definition of a wide moat, and
premium smartphone share has held near 55% for three years. Supplier power, buyer power, and
new-entrant risk all score low in the Porter assessment.

Technicals confirm rather than contradict. Price sits 8.2% above the 200-day SMA with OBV
making higher highs alongside price, the one technical signal this pipeline has validated as
carrying alpha. RSI at 61.3 leaves room before overbought, and participation is rising.

### Bear Case

Manufacturing concentration is the live tail. A 20% China production disruption maps to
roughly a 9% EPS hit, and the 5th-percentile downside scenario lands at $172, 18% below
entry. That scenario is low-probability and high-severity, which is why the position is
stopped at $200.75 rather than sized without protection.

Regulatory unbundling of default-search economics is the structural threat to the moat.
Those payments are near-pure margin, so an adverse ruling compresses the services mix that
the entire bull case rests on. The competitive report flags this as the primary erosion risk,
and no timeline is under the company's control.

Valuation depends on a discount rate that the macro regime could revoke. The bear-case fair
value of $232.00 under a 9.6% WACC is only 10.3% above the current price, so a 120bps rise in
the cost of capital reduces this from a 38% opportunity to a rounding error.

### Key Catalyst & Review Trigger

Q1 FY26 earnings is the confirming event: the thesis requires services growth to stay above
12% and gross margin to hold the expansion. Review immediately on any China production
headline or on an adverse search-economics ruling. Absent those, review at the 45-day mark
when the pattern signal's half-life expires.
